order_basis.en: Gylfaginning 7-9 tells it in this order.

hook.en: The sons of Borr kill the first giant and build the world from his body.

text.en: Óðinn and his brothers, the sons of Borr, kill the giant Ymir; his blood drowns the frost giants, all but Bergelmir.
From his body they make the world: the earth from his flesh, the sea from his blood, the sky from his skull.
From two trees on the shore they make the first humans, Askr and Embla.

order_basis.en: Þrymskviða gives no time; placed among the gods' deeds as a reading aid.

hook.en: A giant steals Mjöllnir and asks for Freyja as his bride; Þórr goes to the wedding in her place.

text.en: Þórr wakes to find his hammer gone.
The giant Þrymr has hidden it deep in the earth and will give it back only for Freyja.
Þórr goes as the bride; when the hammer is laid in his lap to hallow the marriage, he takes it and kills Þrymr.
